plugins.name: corebee
plugins.description: Run your AI customer support from your editor — manage conversations, contacts, knowledge base, analytics, and the chat widget. Includes a remote (hosted) MCP server with OAuth, 10 skills, 4 agents, 4 commands, plus an agent-native signup (`/corebee:signup`) that creates a brand-new Corebee account from your terminal — one email approval, no dashboard (14-day free trial, no card).
